summary: MOBILE frontend-only verification of Exit Engine Fixed% fix. Ran the flow on the Expo web preview (viewport 390x844) as owner. RESULTS: (a) The deploy() PUT /api/settings payload DOES now include BOTH fixed_target_pct AND stop_loss_pct keys (previous single-key bug is structurally fixed at the deploy() level, see workspace.tsx:241). (b) The RELOAD/persistence fix (savedCfgFor at workspace.tsx:194-205 + backHome->loadSettings) IS WORKING: seeded {fixed_target_pct:6, stop_loss_pct:3.5, exit_method_pref:'fixed_pct'} via API, then in-app navigated Workspace -> Modify Global -> Fixed% Method and the Configure step showed 6 and 3.5 (NOT the hardcoded defaults 3/2.2). Also verified after navigating AWAY to Research tab and BACK. (c) The wiz-use-live-exit Switch (research.tsx:198) is present and ON by default (backgroundColor=rgb(20,224,201)=teal 'true' track). ALL 3 requested fixes verified structurally. HOWEVER, a NEW BLOCKING mobile-only regression was discovered while validating (a) end-to-end: when the user types NEW values into the Take-Profit/Stop-Loss fields on Step 3 and taps DEPLOY, the newly-typed values are NEVER committed into the parent cfg state before the PUT fires — the payload sends whatever cfg was initialised to (saved value or default), NOT what the user just typed. Reproduced with 3 different input techniques (page.fill, focus+keyboard.type+Tab, focus+type+dispatch-blur) — the field visually shows '6' and '3.5', input.value is '6' and '3.5', but the captured PUT body is `{"exit_method_pref":"fixed_pct","stop_loss_pct":2.2,"fixed_target_pct":3}`. Root cause: NumRow (workspace.tsx:577-587) uses local state `v` and only calls onSave via onEndEditing, which does NOT fire when the user taps DEPLOY on mobile because the DEPLOY Pressable steals focus without properly blurring the RN-Web input. This makes the whole Fixed%/ATR configure-and-deploy flow broken for any user typing new values — they will silently deploy the OLD saved values (or defaults) instead of what they typed.

ui_bugs.issue: User-typed values in Take-Profit % and Stop-Loss % fields are NOT committed to the parent cfg state before DEPLOY fires. Result: PUT /api/settings sends the OLD/initial values (3/2.2 defaults or last-saved), even though the input visually shows the new values (e.g. 6/3.5). Reproduced 3x with different blur-trigger techniques. Reference: /app/mobile/app/(tabs)/workspace.tsx:577-587 — TextInput only commits via onEndEditing which does not fire reliably in React Native Web when a Pressable steals focus.

integration_issues.flow: Exit Engine → Global → Fixed% → type 6/3.5 → Deploy
integration_issues.issue: Captured PUT body was {"exit_method_pref":"fixed_pct","stop_loss_pct":2.2,"fixed_target_pct":3} — the newly-typed 6/3.5 were dropped. Backend then persisted the wrong (old) values. From the USER perspective on mobile, deploying Fixed% still 'never takes' whatever they typed, which is precisely the bug this iteration was supposed to fix. Note: the fix is CORRECT in intent (both keys are now in the payload structure), but the value-commit bug in NumRow means the user's input still doesn't reach the wire.

react_native_issues.issue: onEndEditing-only commit pattern is fragile in React Native Web. On mobile-web (Expo web preview), tapping the DEPLOY Pressable does not always fire onBlur/onEndEditing on the focused TextInput before the Pressable's onPress runs, so the parent cfg never receives the typed value. On native iOS/Android this may or may not fire depending on keyboardShouldPersistTaps and Pressable placement. Reference: /app/mobile/app/(tabs)/workspace.tsx:577-587

parity_issues.flow: Exit Engine Fixed% Deploy — typed value commit
parity_issues.issue: Web ExitEngineWorkflow.jsx commits input values on every change (or on blur AND on submit), so web reliably deploys the exact values the user typed. Mobile drops the typed values because NumRow only commits via onEndEditing which is not reliably fired by tap-to-deploy on the RN-Web preview.
parity_issues.expected: Mobile DEPLOY payload contains the exact user-typed values (e.g. fixed_target_pct=6, stop_loss_pct=3.5)
parity_issues.actual: Mobile DEPLOY payload contains the OLD saved values or initial defaults (e.g. fixed_target_pct=3, stop_loss_pct=2.2) even though the input fields visually show 6/3.5

action_items: CRITICAL: Fix NumRow (workspace.tsx:577-587) to commit input values on EVERY change, not only onEndEditing. Simplest fix: change `onChangeText={setV}` to `onChangeText={(x) => { setV(x); onSave(k, x); }}` so each keystroke updates the parent cfg. Alternative: remove the local `v` state entirely and use `value={cfg[k]}` + `onChangeText={(x) => setF(k, x)}` in the parent (single source of truth). Either fix will make the Deploy flow actually persist typed values on mobile.
LOW: consider also committing onBlur (`onBlur={() => onSave(k, v)}`) as belt-and-suspenders even if the main fix goes with onChangeText commits.
critical_code_review_comments: workspace.tsx:241 — deploy() correctly includes BOTH fixed_target_pct AND stop_loss_pct for fixed_pct method. Structural fix verified. But it uses `cfg.target_pct` / `cfg.stop_pct` which stay at their initialisation values if NumRow never fires onSave (see bug above).

workspace.tsx:194-205 — savedCfgFor() correctly reads settings.fixed_target_pct and settings.stop_loss_pct, and pick() at L207 correctly merges { ...DEFAULTS[m.id], ...savedCfgFor(m.id) } so re-entering the flow shows saved values. Verified: after API-seed to 6/3.5, Config step showed 6/3.5. This is the CORE bug fix and it works.
workspace.tsx:73 — backHome() calls loadSettings() so returning to Exit Engine home refreshes settings from the API. Good.
research.tsx:126 — useLive default is true, so wiz-use-live-exit is ON by default. Verified visually via track backgroundColor=teal.

workspace.tsx:577-587 — NumRow local-state + onEndEditing-only-commit is the root cause of the new regression. The fix should hoist commit to onChangeText (or remove local buffering entirely). This is a mobile-only issue because web uses a different form control pattern.

success_rate.frontend: mobile: 2/3 fixes verified end-to-end; the 3rd fix (deploy payload contains both keys) is structurally correct but blocked at runtime by an unrelated NumRow value-commit regression

seed_data_creation: Direct PUT /api/settings via evaluate() with {fixed_target_pct:6, stop_loss_pct:3.5, exit_method_pref:'fixed_pct'} to isolate the reload code path from the value-commit bug. Backend now has these persisted for owner. UI-driven deploys during this iteration re-wrote the OLD values (3/2.2) due to the NumRow bug — so current server state is {fixed_target_pct:6, stop_loss_pct:3.5} (from the API seed which ran last).
context_for_next_testing_agent: To reproduce the NumRow commit bug: (1) login as owner on Expo web preview at EXPO_PACKAGER_PROXY_URL; (2) dismiss 'Coming Soon' promo (Continue to Cockpit); (3) tab-workspace; (4) ee-modify-global; (5) ee-method-fixed_pct; (6) note initial config values; (7) type new values into ee-set-target_pct and ee-set-stop_pct — visually they update; (8) tap ee-next-3 then ee-deploy; (9) intercept /api/settings PUT — body will contain the INITIAL values, NOT the typed values. This is a mobile-only issue; web-side ExitEngineWorkflow.jsx uses a different pattern and is unaffected.
rca of the issue: The user's original bug ('Fixed% Target + Stop config kept reverting to 3%/2.2%') has TWO independent root causes: (1) deploy() previously only sent stop_loss_pct not fixed_target_pct → FIXED (workspace.tsx:241 now sends both). (2) Configure step previously used hardcoded defaults regardless of saved settings → FIXED (workspace.tsx:194-207 now merges savedCfgFor over DEFAULTS). BUT a third, PRE-EXISTING mobile-only bug has now become visible because of the fix: NumRow commits typed values only via onEndEditing, which does not reliably fire when the user taps DEPLOY on RN-Web. So the user still sees their typed values reverting — not because the deploy code is wrong, but because the typed values never reach cfg. Recommended fix: commit on onChangeText (single source of truth pattern) in NumRow at /app/mobile/app/(tabs)/workspace.tsx:577-587.
